title: 第2520章 为所欲为第2519章 一切尽在不言中
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
看到这幅画面，黄夜突然想到一句经典台词——大爷，玩玩呗。
“仙子，实在不好意思，我们有纪律，不能仗着特权吃拿卡要，为所欲为。”
“监察使，这叫什么话，您在外面应该看到了，这是我们的常态。”
“我们合欢帝宫不论男修还是女修，只要双方愿意，随时随地都可以互联互通，这不算占便宜，更不算利用特权。”
黄夜一头黑线，没想到互联互通还可以这么运用。
“仙子，我能理解您的想法，我也不反对这种操作，男欢女爱是人之常情，双方只要你情我愿，没人能管。”
“可我毕竟不是合欢帝宫修士，上面一旦知道我这么做，肯定会收拾我，他们可不会听我解释。”
“我找这份工作也不容易，不想因为管不住自己丢了饭碗。”
黄夜无奈地摊摊手。
“监察使，你都说这是你情我愿的事儿，更何况这事天知地知你知我知，只要我不说，肯定没人知道。”
刘嫚锲而不舍。
“临来之前，上面警告过我，一定要自律，即便对方不告密，也不能乱来。”
“我也是这么想的，如果这次我抱着侥幸心理胡作非为，或许能瞒过去，下次再遇到这种情况，我的胆子肯定更大一些。”
“长此以往，我便会无所顾忌，常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋。”
“更何况天下没有不透风的墙，还是自律一些好，就算遇到看我不顺眼的小人告发我，只要我什么也没做，说话的底气也硬。”
黄夜再次表明态度。
刘嫚眼中露出一丝失望之色，眼前这位监察使虽然看起来很平凡，但他身上带着一股英气，年纪还不大，一定是非常不错的人选。
尤其这小子还不是合欢帝宫修士，更有一种新奇感，以前自己也接触过其他帝宫过来的修士，感觉都很棒。
可这小子明显油盐不进，用一堆话搪塞自己，摆明不配合自己。
唉，看来这块肥肉不属于自己，只能看到却吃不到。

“对不起，是我唐突了，您既然没这个想法，奴家便不强求了。”
“谢谢您能满意我这里的表现，奴家会一如既往地维护沈家名声。”
“嗯，相信你能做到，对了，还有一件事需要仙子出面操作。”
黄夜点点头，开始切入正题。
“监察使请讲。”
“上面让我寻找一个女修，她应该在百年前被劫掠到合欢帝宫，只是不知她被劫到什么地方。”
“仙子可以在这里发布寻人启事，如果你能找到这个女修，上面除了给你奖励，还会让代理商增加你的份额。”
黄夜以利诱之。
“哦，这可是好事儿，奴家一定尽力寻找，不知这个女修都有什么特征？”
黄夜把佟姥的特征告诉刘嫚，还提供了佟姥的照片以及一同消失那两人的特征，随后又把系统编写的寻人启事文本交给这妞。
“这是我草拟的寻人启事，仙子看看有什么地方需要改动。”
content_en:
Seeing this picture, Huang Ye suddenly thought of a classic line - Uncle, just have fun.
"Fairy, I'm really sorry. We have discipline. We can't take advantage of our privileges to do whatever we want."
"Inspector, what are you talking about? You should have seen it outside. This is our normal state."
"In our Hehuan Imperial Palace, whether male or female cultivators, as long as both parties are willing, they can communicate with each other anytime and anywhere. This is not taking advantage, let alone taking advantage of privileges."
Huang Ye was confused and didn't expect that interconnection could be used in this way.
"Fairy, I can understand your thoughts, and I am not opposed to this kind of operation. It is human nature for a man to love a woman. As long as both parties are willing to love each other, no one can control it."
"But after all, I am not a monk from the Hehuan Imperial Palace. Once the superiors know that I have done this, they will definitely deal with me. They will not listen to my explanation."
"It's not easy for me to find this job. I don't want to lose my job because I can't control myself."
Huang Ye spread his hands helplessly.
"Inspector, you said this is a matter of your own free will. What's more, God knows that you know it and I know it. As long as I don't say it, no one will know."
Liu Man persevered.
"Before coming, I was warned by the superiors that I must be self-disciplined. Even if the other party does not inform me, I cannot act recklessly."
"That's what I think too. If I do something random this time with a sense of luck, I might be able to hide it. Next time I encounter this kind of situation, I will definitely be more courageous."
"If things continue like this, I will have no worries and will often walk by the river without getting my shoes wet."
"What's more, there is no airtight wall in the world. It's better to be more self-disciplined. Even if I encounter a villain who doesn't like me and accuses me, as long as I don't do anything, I will have the confidence to speak."
Huang Ye expressed his attitude again.
There was a trace of disappointment in Liu Man's eyes. Although the inspector in front of him looked ordinary, he had a heroic spirit and was still young. He must be a very good candidate.
Especially since this boy is not yet a monk from the Hehuan Imperial Palace, he feels even more novel. He has also interacted with monks from other imperial palaces before, and they all felt great.
But this guy was obviously out of his depth. He used a lot of words to explain himself and made it clear that he would not cooperate with him.
Alas, it seems that this piece of fat does not belong to me. I can only see it but cannot eat it.
"I'm sorry, I was rude. Since you don't have this idea, I won't force you."
"Thank you for being satisfied with my performance here. The Nu family will continue to maintain the reputation of the Shen family."
"Well, I believe you can do it. By the way, there is one more thing that the fairy needs to do."
Huang Ye nodded and started to get to the point.
"Inspector, please speak."
"I was asked to find a female cultivator from above. She should have been robbed to the Hehuan Emperor Palace a hundred years ago, but I don't know where she was robbed."
"The fairy can post a missing person notice here. If you can find this female nun, in addition to giving you a reward, the agent will also increase your share."
Huang Ye lured him with benefits.
"Oh, this is a good thing. I will try my best to look for her. What are the characteristics of this female nun?"
Huang Ye told Liu Man the characteristics of Tong Lao, and also provided photos of Tong Lao and the characteristics of the two people who disappeared together. Then he gave the missing person notice text written by the system to this girl.
"This is the missing person notice I drafted. Fairy, see if there is anything that needs to be changed."
